title: Outside the tourist destinations
text: We asked Mary to plan a tour to see the real life of the Catalans. We already know tourist destinations, but how and where do the inhabitants of Barcelona live, what do you do in your spare time, that is what interested us. Mary told us a lot of interesting things and showed us. It was a beautiful day. Next time we are in Barcelona, we know that we will contact Maria again beforehand. Maria speaks very good German and is very friendly. It responds great to wishes. Top recommendation for a private tour of Barcelona.
author: Mario_Daniela-Luca-G

title: Excellent 2-day tour of Barcelona
text: My wife and I had a great 2-day tour of Barcelona with Maria who expertly structured the tours to meet our request that the pace be leisurely, not too tiring and a maximum of 4 hours per day. Maria had limousine to drive us around Barcelona with stops on important sites such as the Montjuic Hill, Olympic stadium, Casa Batllo, La Pedrera and the La Sagrada Familia Cathedral. Maria walked us around the old town and introduced us to some Catalan cuisine. I strongly recommend Maria if you are looking for private and customized tours.

title: Maria, Private Tour Guide
text:
Maria was awesome!  She knows all the ins and out of Barcelona and took us to ll the places we wanted to see.  Her knowledge of the history of the city was amazing.  Her passion for the city made our tour very exciting.  

Maria was punctual in picking us up and made sure we weren't rushed as we had an older person in our group.  She spent half a day with us and also had a driver take us on a scenic tour around the city.  

I would recommend her in a flash!
author: Debbbug

title: Barcelona Walkiing  tour:
text: Maria Nadina is an excellent guide. We have used her twice for  two different tours at two different trips to Barcelona in 2016 and 2018. We have recommended her to friends. She is prompt, caring, knowledgeable, organized and speaks excellent English. We will use her very professional and friendly services again if our 2021 trip to Barcelona comes to fruition. She is highly recommended. Lynn S. (Alabama)
author: Lynn S

title: Barcelona with Maria Nadina
text: Maria was a wonderful guide. She took us on a walking tour of Barcelona that explored the nooks and crannies that tourists would never see on their own. Her knowledge of the history of Catalonia, Spain, and Europe was superb. It was a truly amazing experience. We highly recommend her.
author: Ludy B
